## 问题与目的 / Problem and purpose

<!-- What user problem does this solve? Link an issue if there is one. -->

## 改动与结果 / Changes and resulting behavior

<!-- Explain the approach and scope. Add before/after screenshots for UI changes. -->

## 验证 / Validation

<!-- List checks actually run and their results. State untested areas explicitly. -->

## 硬件与兼容性（适用时）/ Hardware and compatibility, if applicable

<!-- Model, firmware, HDMI/DP/dock, HDR/ECO, raw write/read values and visible effects.
     Distinguish simulator tests from physical hardware. Remove private identifiers. -->

## 提交前 / Before review

- [ ] 已阅读贡献指南，改动范围清楚 / Read CONTRIBUTING; scope is focused.
- [ ] 已说明验证结果与剩余风险 / Reported relevant checks and remaining uncertainty.
- [ ] 已按需更新文档、CHANGELOG 和翻译 / Updated docs, changelog and locales where relevant.
- [ ] 未包含凭据或私人设备数据，保留第三方来源与许可 / No secrets/private device data; third-party notices retained.
